statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
The procedure is needed to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events
The procedure is to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
